checkRuns.command:
cd /home/kaynooo/.cache/llm-bench/opus-sandbox/solidstart-1/site
bun add -d @types/node 2>&1 | tail -1; sed -i 's/"types": \["vite\/client"\]/"types": ["vite\/client", "node"]/' tsconfig.json; bun run check 2>&1 | tail -20 && bun run build 2>&1 | tail -15

cd /home/kaynooo/.cache/llm-bench/opus-sandbox/solidstart-1/site
pgrep -af "index.mjs" | grep -v pgrep; bun run check && bun run build >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo built

cd /home/kaynooo/.cache/llm-bench/opus-sandbox/solidstart-1/site; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:4701/books/frankenstein | grep -o '' | sed 's///g; s/ data-hk="[^"]*"//g'; kill $(cat /tmp/srv.pid); sleep 1; pgrep -af index.mjs | grep -v pgrep cat > content/books/zz-test.md <<'EOF' --- title: Aaa Test author: Someone year: 1900 rating: 5 tags: [zeta] --- Hello **world**. EOF bun run build >/dev/null 2>&1; PORT=4702 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4702 NODE_ENV=production nohup bun run start > /tmp/srv.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/srv.pid; sleep 2 curl -s http://127.0.0.1:4702/ | grep -o '' | sed 's///g; s/ data-hk="[^"]*"//g'; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:4702/books | grep -o 'zeta\|Aaa Test' | sort | uniq -c; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:4702/books/zz-test kill $(cat /tmp/srv.pid); rm content/books/zz-test.md; git status --short

cd /home/kaynooo/.cache/llm-bench/opus-sandbox/solidstart-1/site; bun run build >/dev/null 2>&1; PORT=4701 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4701 NODE_ENV=production nohup bun run start > /tmp/srv.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/srv.pid; sleep 2; curl -s http://127.0.0.1:4701/books/frankenstein | tr '\n' ' ' | grep -o '<article.*</article>' | sed 's/<!--[^>]*-->//g; s/ data-hk="[^"]*"//g'; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:4701/_build/assets/$(ls .output/public/_build/assets | grep entry-client.*js); cat /tmp/srv.log
